course_name: 鐵道車輛系統與維修基地
outline:
「鐵道車輛系統與維修基地」課程，本課程包括:世界各國高鐵的發展與其關鍵，台灣為何需要高鐵；高鐵的核心系統包括:列車，電力，架空線，集電弓，號誌及通訊系統；列車的特徵，要求及類型；列車的結構包括:車身，轉向架及煞車系統；列車的安全及所發生的事故，列車上的便利設施；列車的動力系統及馬達；高鐵的電力系統及變壓器；架空線及集電弓系統；歐美及日本的列車耐撞性規範；號誌及列車控制系統。台灣高鐵的事件自動通報系統，工程車路徑輔助系統；PLC替代繼電器專案計畫；通訊系統，地震預警系統及災害告警系統；高鐵車站所扮演的角色及車站空間需求設計；未來的磁浮高鐵系統及超導體技術之運用:高鐵維修機廠之布置及台灣高鐵工程及技術移轉之沿革；軌道經驗與分享。
This course includes: the development of high-speed rail (HSR) in various countries and its key factors, and why Taiwan needs high-speed rail; the core systems of high-speed rail, including: trains, power, overhead catenary, pantographs, signaling, and communication systems; the characteristics, requirements, and types of trains; the structure of trains, including: car body, bogies, and braking systems; train safety and accidents that occur, and the amenities on board; train power systems and motors; high-speed rail power systems and transformers; overhead catenary and pantograph systems; train crashworthiness regulations in Europe, America, and Japan; signaling and train control systems, Taiwan high-speed rail event automatic reporting system, and the work train route auxiliary system; the PLC replacement of relay project; communication systems, earthquake early warning systems, and disaster warning systems; the role of high-speed rail stations and station space requirement design; future magnetic levitation high-speed rail systems and the application of superconducting technology; the layout of high-speed rail maintenance depots, and the history of Taiwan high-speed rail engineering and technology transfer; railway experience and sharing.
schedule:
第1週 課程說明及教學方式選定 Course description and teaching method selection
第2週 世界各國高鐵介紹 Introduction of the world High Speed Rail(HSR)
第3週 高鐵發展之關鍵 Keys to the development  of HSR
第4週 高鐵列車之特徵，要求及類型 Characteristics, requirements and types of HSR
第5週 高鐵列車之車身，轉向架及煞車系統 Car body, bogie and braking system of HSR Trains
第6週 高鐵列車之安全及事故；列車上的便利設施 HSR Train safety and incidents, On board amenities
第7週 列車的動力系統及馬達；高鐵的電力系統及變壓器 HSR traction power and motor, HSR power system and transformer
第8週 高鐵的架空線系統及集電弓 HSR overhead catenary system(OCS) and pantograph
第9週 期中分組專題報告 Group presentation mid-term  report
第10週 歐美及日本的耐撞性規範；號誌及列車控制系統；台灣高鐵事件通報系統及工程車路徑輔助系統；PLC替代繼電器專案計畫 Europe, US and Japan crashworthiness. Signaling and train control. THSR EARS and WTRAS system. PLC replacement of relay project
第11週 高鐵的通訊系統，地震告警系統及災害告警系統 HSR communication system, earthquake warning system and disaster warning system(DWS)
第12週 高鐵車站所扮演的角色及車站空間需求的設計 The role of HSR stations and special design
第13週 未來高鐵的磁浮系統 The future HSR maglev system
第14週 未來高鐵運用超導體的磁浮系統 The future super conductive(SC) HSR system
第15週 高鐵的維修機廠佈置及台灣高鐵工程及技術移轉的沿革 HSR maintenance depot and THSR engineering and technical transfer
第16週 軌道經驗分享 Rail experiences sharing
第17週 台灣高鐵設施參訪或分組專題期末報告 THSR facility visit or group presentation final report
第18週 期末分組專題報告 Group presentation final report
